project_name: Vortex Cloud Gaming - Xbox Game Pass Style
archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / XBOX GAME PASS AESTHETIC

design_philosophy.core_identity: High-density Xbox Game Pass visual interface for WebRTC PC Game Streaming with local Sunshine/Moonlight host integration.
anti_ai_rules: NO generic light gray or basic indigo gradients; use Xbox Deep Charcoal (#0F171E, #121212) with Xbox Emerald Green (#107C41, #108040) highlights
NO center-everything disease: use asymmetrical hero banners with strong left-aligned typography and horizontal tile carousels
NO plain HTML controls for gamepad: render authentic Xbox controller layout with styled touch thumbsticks, ABXY signature color accents, and responsive touch feedback

hierarchy.hero_title: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tight uppercase

nav_bar.style: sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0F171E]/90 border-b border-[#21262D] px-6 py-3 flex items-center justify-between
nav_bar.logo: VORTEX CLOUD - Xbox Game Pass visual badge in Green & Charcoal

hero_carousel.container: relative w-full h-[420px] rounded-2xl overflow-hidden border border-[#21262D] bg-[#161B22] shadow-2xl mb-10
hero_carousel.overlay: bg-gradient-to-r from-[#0D1117] via-[#0D1117]/70 to-transparent p-8 sm:p-12 flex flex-col justify-end

game_grid.horizontal_scroll: flex gap-4 overflow-x-auto pb-4 scrollbar-thin scrollbar-thumb-emerald-700 scrollbar-track-transparent
game_grid.portrait_card: w-48 flex-shrink-0 group relative rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-[#161B22] border border-[#21262D] transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-105 hover:border-[#107C41] hover:shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(16,124,65,0.4)] cursor-pointer

virtual_gamepad_spec.layout: Landscape overlay for mobile touch or screen streaming

components.left_stick: Virtual touch joystick for movement (L3 click)
components.right_stick: Virtual touch joystick for camera look (R3 click)
components.dpad: Cross directional pad with green active highlights
components.abxy_cluster: Signature Xbox ABXY layout (A: Green, B: Red, X: Blue, Y: Yellow)
components.bumpers_triggers: LB / LT top left buttons, RB / RT top right triggers
components.center_buttons: View, Menu (Start/Select) and Xbox Guide logo button in center

virtual_gamepad_spec.bluetooth_support: HTML5 Gamepad API listener with automatic auto-hide on physical controller detection

streaming_player.container: relative w-full h-screen bg-black overflow-hidden flex items-center justify-center
streaming_player.hud_overlay: absolute top-4 left-4 right-4 flex items-center justify-between bg-[#0F171E]/80 backdrop-blur-md p-3 rounded-xl border border-[#21262D] z-40 text-xs text-white
streaming_player.launch_modal: Game Launch sheet providing dual actions: 'Jogar no Navegador (WebRTC/Sunshine)' and 'Abrir no Moonlight App (moonlight://launch)'

sections: Status da Captura de Tela & Agent Local
Pastas de Jogos no PC (C:\Jogos, D:\SteamLibrary)
Pareamento Sunshine & Chave PIN de Conexão
Clientes Conectados & Métricas de Latência em Tempo Real

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Ensure all interactive buttons, inputs, game cards, and HUD controls have unique data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='game-card-launch-btn')
Maintain high APCA contrast with light text on deep charcoal backgrounds (#0D1117 / #161B22)
Use smooth micro-interactions (hover scale-105, green neon glow shadow, active tap states)
Always provide PT-BR localization across all tabs, modals, game settings, and controller mappings
